question: Related Questions Q. My wife before our marriage had made an niyath to keep nafl fast on monday and thursday after our nikah for the rest of her life. But due to some reasons she is not able to keep it regularly. Hence she skips it sometimes. I like to know is there is any alternative for the niyath she has made as per Islamic shariah. Kindly reply at the earliest because since missing of fast makes both of us feel guilty and we are not able to overcome that. 5341 views Q. Salatul Ishraq 2069 views Q. I have taken oath on Quran to quit smoking but could not stop it .Then two more times my wife forced me to take oath upon placing hands on quran to quit smoking.i seriously want to quit smoking but am unable .What should I do now to repent and seek Allah SWT forgiveness .what kuffara should I give? 9693 views Q. I am an Indian living in UAE.In your Fatwa: 1409/1125=L=1430 you used the word "verbally".I want to know what did you mean by "verbally".Does that mean that a person has to say the vow loudly so that the person himself listens to it or should he say it in presence of someone else.My second part of the question is;A VOW INTENDED INTERNALLY WITHIN HIMSELF IS A VALID ONE OR NOT?Please do reply as soon as possible. 2048 views Q. One of my mom's friends is constantly making excessive minnats (for example, I will pray 200 salat-ut-tasbeeh, or finish the quran 50 times if such and such a thing happens). After the her duaa is accepted and the event happens she is unable to fulfill her minnat and almost forces my mom to help her fulfill it; for example, you read quran 40 times, I'll read it 10 times. Because the person is asking you to do a good deed you cannot refuse it, but it is also difficult to carry out the minnat within the period of time the friend gives. For this reason I was wondering if it is alright to tell the person to 1. not make such excessive minnats that you can't fulfill yourself 2. to pray or carry out the good deed before you make the duaa (since making minnat is sort of like playing with allah). answer: Prayers & Duties >> Oaths & Vows Question ID: 41549 Country: India Title: Oath Question: Once my father took an oath of the holy Quran for doing a particular deed but now he as well as me and my family do not want to do that. Now please tell me about the kaffarah of this oath. Answer ID: 41549 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1721/1337/B=1433) The kaffarah of oath shall be wajib on you if you fail to fulfil the task which you swore to do in future. The kaffarah of oath is to feed 10 poor persons two times a day. But if one is poor and does not have capacity to feed the poor then he should keep fast of three days consecutively. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
